List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Friday, the December 20, 2002/Agrahayana 29, 1924 (Saka)

(Ministries :  Agriculture; Chemicals and Fertilizers; Environment and

Total number of questions—20

CII's suggestions on drought
*441.SHRI RUMANDLA
RAAMACHANDRAYYA:
SHRI RAJKUMAR DHOOT:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Confederation of Indian
Industry (CII) has suggested a series of short
and long term measures, to help the States
cope up with drought in the country;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the response of Government on these
suggestions?
Johannesburg Summit on biodiversity
sharing
*442. MISS MABEL REBELLO:
SHRI B.J. PANDA:
Will the Minister of ENVIRONMENT
AND FORESTS be pleased to state:
(a) whether India participated in the
Summit on biodiversity sharing and water,
sanitation access, held in Johannesburg;
(b) if so, the plans formulated on the
subject in the Summit; and
(c) the issues which the Indian delegation
managed to press?
Ecological havoc in Aravali Hills
*443. SHRI KARNENDU BHATTA-
CHARJEE: Will the Minister of
ENVIRONMENT AND FORESTS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government's attention has
been drawn to the newsreport captioned,
'Ecological havoc in Aravali Hills', published
in The Times of India, dated the
1st November, 2002;
(b) whether Government have drawn up
any plan to stem the rapid exploitation of
the Aravali Hills, to meet the growing urban
requirements; and
(c) if so, the details thereof and if not,
the reasons therefor?
Uniform staffing pattern in Central
Universities
*444. SHRI V.V. RAGHAVAN: Will
the Minister of HUMAN RESOURCE
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the UGC has
set up a Committee to consider uniform

134

staffing pattern, conditions of service for
the employees of Central Universities;
(b) if so, whether that Committee has
completed its task and submitted its
recommendations; and
(c) if so, the gist of the recommendations
and Government's reaction thereto?
Environment protection awareness
†*445. SHRI HARISH RAWAT: Will
the Minister of ENVIRONMENT AND
FORESTS be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Ministry of
Environment and Forests are preparing
some action plan to encourage
environment protection awareness in the
States, that are sensitive from environment
point of view;
(b) whether there is a proposal to include
forest and environment promotion in the
school courses in such States; and
(c) if so, the details thereof?
Central Universities in Rajasthan and
Orissa
†*446. SHRI JANESHWAR
MISHRA: Will the Minister of HUMAN
RESOURCE DEVELOPMENT be pleased
to state:
(a) the present number of Central
universities in the country, State-wise;
(b) the norms prescribed for
granting Central University status to a
university;
(c) whether it is a fact that there is no
Central University in States, like Rajasthan
and Orissa; and
(d) if so, the reasons for the same?
KVKs in States
*447.SHRI JANARDHANA
POOJARY:
SHRI K. RAHMAN KHAN:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE
be pleased to state:
(a) what are the objectives and guidelines
for establishment of Krishi Vigyan Kendras
in States;
(b) the number of such Centres
established so far, State-wise;
(c) whether proposals have been
received for establishment of such Centres
in the newly created States and districts;
and
(d) if so, the details in this regard?
Rakes for animal fodder
*448. SHRI RAVULA CHANDRA
SEKAR REDDY: Will the Minister of
RAILWAYS be pleased to state:
(a) whether Andhra Pradesh has
requested the South Central Railway to
provide more rakes for transportation of
animal fodder to drought affected areas in
the State, free of cost; and
(b) if so, Government's response to the
request?
Memorandum from tribal organisation
regarding rehabilitation
†*449. SHRI MOTILAL VORA:
SHRI MAN MOHAN SAMAL:
Will the Minister of ENVIRONMENT
AND FORESTS be pleased to state:
(a)  whether his Ministry had written to
Chief Secretaries, Forest Secretaries and

3rd May, 2002, to evict the encroachers on

(b) if so, whether these orders cover the

affected by these orders in the State;
(c) whether the Ministry has received
any memorandum from the tribal
organisations, in this regard;
(d) the steps taken by Government for
rehabilitation of tribals and to sort out their
problems; and
(e) if not, the reasons therefor?

Sugarcane production in Orissa
3116. SHRI SURENDRA LATH: Will
the Minister of AGRICULTURE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government have a proposal
to increase the areas under sugarcane
production in Orissa;
(b) if so, the steps taken by Government
in that regard; and
(c) the details of target set therefor, for
the Tenth Five Year Plan for Orissa and
other States?
Drought-assistance to States
3117. DR. ALLADI P. RAJKUMAR:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) the number of States that have
declared the entire State and the number of
States that have declared certain districts, as
drought affected;
(b) the amount of assistance provided
by the Central Government to drought
affected States, State-wise; and
(c) the details of other facilities provided
to States by different Central Government
agencies, organizations?
National policy for farmers
†3118. PROF. M. M.  AGARWAL: Will
the Minister of AGRICULTURE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government have
formulated any national policy for improving
the economic conditions of the Indian
farmers;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) if not, the reasons therefor?
Problems of applicants for import
permits for meal imports
3119. SHRI S. AGNIRAJ: Will the
Minister of AGRICULTURE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that a proper
mechanism to solve the grievances of
applicants for import permits does not exist;

682
WIN2\SESSION\6519RS-QUES 682
(b) whether it is a fact that the concerned
officers are irresponsible and refuse to meet
the public who come with genuine problems;
and
(c) what steps are being taken to make
the whole process of issue import permits
transparent, as in other Departments?
Research projects for agricultural
productivity
3120. SHRI R. KAMARAJ: Will the
Minister of AGRICULTURE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Government have proposed
to implement any new research project for
increasing agricultural productivity, under
Tenth Five Year Plan;
(b) if so, the details thereof and the funds
allocated for the project, State-wise; and
(c) if not, the reasons therefor?
Boosting milk yield
3121. SHRI RAVULA CHANDRA
SEKAR REDDY: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that, as announced
by Australian Scientists who have completed
a three years project in India, the protein
food can boost milk yield in Indian cows;
and
(b) if so, when India's National Dairy
Development Board would be implementing
the same?
Boosting agricultural exports
3122. SHRI RAJEEV SHUKLA:
DR. ABRAR AHMED:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have taken any
decision for removal of restriction on
agricultural exports, to boost country's
agricultural exports; and
(b) if so, the details thereof?
Subsidising urea for drought affected
States
3123. SHRI P. G. NARAYANAN: Will
the Minister of AGRICULTURE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government have any
proposal to subsidise Urea, for the benefit
of farmers in drought-affected States;
(b) whether Government have made any
long-term planning to face such natural
disaster; and
(c) if so, the details thereof?
Bhoomi e-governance project of
Karnataka
3124. SHRIMATI PREMA
CARIAPPA: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Bhoomi e-governance
Project of Karnataka for Computerising
20 million rural land records, received
Stockholm Challenge Award, if so, which
are the other Indian e-governance projects
selected for the above award; and
(b) whether there is any proposal with
Government to implement the above project
in other States also?
Pathetic conditions of agricultural
labourers in Tamil Nadu
3125. SHRI R. KAMARAJ: Will the
Minister of AGRICULTURE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Government are aware that
Thanjavour and Trichy regions of

agriculture only;
(b) whether Government are also aware
of the pathetic conditions of the agricultural
labourers, at the time of monsoon failure;
(c) if so, whether Government would
consider to have heavy industries in that
region, in order to provide employment for
these unemployed labourers; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?

(a) the number of cases from Orissa

for taking up Brackish water
